# Bhavy Ladani

> Product Engineer with 4+ years building full-stack web apps. Open to opportunities. Based in Ahmedabad, India.

## About

Bhavy Ladani is a Product Engineer currently working at Anblicks Inc. as Software Developer 2 (June 2024 – present). Previously at Weboccult Technologies (August 2022 – May 2024) and Codeflash Infotech (internship, 2022). He holds a B.Tech in Computer Science from Gujarat Technological University (2019–2023, 8.54 GPA).

- [Portfolio](https://bhavyladani.vercel.app): Main site with projects, experience, writing, and contact
- [Resume](https://bhavyladani.vercel.app/BhavyLadani_SoftwareDeveloper.pdf): Full CV / PDF

## Projects

- [Ahmedabad Metro Tracker](https://ahmedabad-metro-tracker.vercel.app/): Live PWA for the GMRC Ahmedabad Metro — real-time train positions on a MapLibre map, journey planner with fare and transfer details, offline support
- [Fixitt](https://fixitt.vercel.app/): 40+ privacy-first browser-based file tools — PDF, image, OCR, and data utilities, fully offline-capable as a PWA
- [LockKaro](https://lockkaro.vercel.app): Private document vault built with Next.js 15 and Supabase — IDs, insurance, degrees with expiry tracking and reminders
- [Splititt](https://splititt.vercel.app/): Group expense splitter with real-time Supabase sync and optimized settlement suggestions
- [Life In Weeks](https://gridoflife.vercel.app): Life visualization as a scrollable grid of weeks — pin memories, define eras, download as phone wallpaper
- [Claude Dashboard](https://github.com/bhavy67/claude-dashboard): Local analytics dashboard for Claude Code token usage and session history — nothing leaves your machine
